programme.title: Witnesses: Vlado Klopčič, Mon. / Pričevalci: Vlado Klopčič, pon.
programme.sub-title: Vlado Klopčič, rojen leta 1904 v Ljubljani, izhaja iz premožne železničarske družine z močno versko vzgojo. Mladost je preživel v Mostah, v času, ko je življenje potekalo mirno in dostojno. Med drugo svetovno vojno se je kot najstnik vključil v odporniš
programme.desc: After the war, he encountered poverty and a complicated political environment. He was not a member of the party, which made it impossible for him to advance in his career. The witness speaks openly about communist repression, post-war massacres, staged trials and the fates of people who were labeled traitors by the authorities. His own brother was shot as a -suspected- informant. Klopčič points out abuses of power, political staffing and injustices caused by the one-party system. Despite everything, he himself remained alive, as a witness of a time that he did not forget. / Po vojni se je srečal z revščino in zapletenim političnim okoljem. Ni bil član partije, kar mu je onemogočilo karierno napredovanje. Pričevalec odkrito spregovori o komunistični represiji, povojnih pobojih, montiranih procesih ter usodah ljudi, ki so jih oblasti označile za izdajalce. Njegov lastni brat je bil ustreljen kot -suma- obveščevalec. Klopčič opozarja na zlorabe oblasti, politična kadrovanja in krivice, ki jih je povzročil enopartijski sistem. Kljub vsemu je sam ostal pri življenju, kot pričevalec nekega časa, ki ni pozabil.

programme.title: General Boroević, documentary film, Mon. / General Boroević, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Pečenko Valentin... Življenjska zgodba karizmatičnega branilca Soče, generala Svetozara Boroevića, edinega nenemškega feldmaršala avstro-ogrske monarhije.
programme.desc: Director and screenwriter Valentin Pečenko portrays Boroević's journey "from glory and stars to fall and oblivion", which is also symbolically the story of the collapse of the eternal Habsburg monarchy. One of the greatest military leaders of the First World War is forgotten and died in poverty in May 1920 at the age of 64 in Klagenfurt. His funeral in Vienna, which was attended by thousands of people, was held without state honors. His grave was paid for by the last Austrian emperor, Charles, from exile. General Boroević, as the commander of the Soča army, defeated the Italians against all expectations, who were clearly superior in both infantry and weapons. The mayor of Ljubljana, Ivan Tavčar, named him an honorary citizen of Ljubljana in August 1915 for his services in the defense of the Soča front, but he was removed from this list already in June 1919 at the suggestion of the city's personal legal council. In 2009, the city municipality of Ljubljana returned the title of honorary citizen to General Boroević. Many renowned domestic and foreign historians and history scholars contribute to the diversity of the film. They talk about General Boroević in seven European languages ​​and evaluate the role and importance of the defender of the Carpathians and the legendary commander of the Soča front from different perspectives. In Primorska and the areas along the Soča River, his memory is still very much alive, as are the legends and ice names after him. Many lesser-known facts about Boroević and the First World War will be presented to the wider Slovenian public for the first time in the film. / Režiser in scenarist Valentin Pečenko odstira Boroevićevo pot »od slave in zvezd do padca in pozabe«, ki je simbolično tudi zgodba propada večne habsburške monarhije. Eden največjih vojskovodij prve svetovne vojne je pozabljen in v pomanjkanju maja 1920 umrl v 64. letu starosti v Celovcu. Njegov pogreb na Dunaju, ki se ga je udeležilo več tisoč ljudi, je potekal brez državniških časti. Grob mu je iz izgnanstva plačal zadnji avstrijski cesar Karel. General Boroević je kot poveljnik soške armade proti vsem pričakovanjem porazil Italijane, ki so bili v izraziti premoči tako v pehoti kot orožju. Ljubljanski župan Ivan Tavčar ga je zaradi zaslug pri obrambi soške fronte avgusta 1915 imenoval za častnega meščana Ljubljane, a so ga že junija 1919 na predlog mestnega personalno pravnega sveta črtali s tega seznama. Leta 2009 je mestna občina Ljubljana generalu Boroeviću naziv častnega meščana vrnila. K raznolikosti filma pripomorejo številni priznani domači in tuji zgodovinarji ter preučevalci zgodovine. O generalu Boroeviću spregovorijo v sedmih evropskih jezikih in z različnih vidikov presojajo vlogo in pomen branilca Karpatov in legendarnega poveljnika soške fronte. Na Primorskem in krajih ob reki Soči je spomin nanj še vedno zelo živ, kot tudi legende in ledinska imena po njem. Marsikatero manj znano dejstvo o Boroeviću in prvi svetovni vojni pa bo širši slovenski javnosti v filmu predstavljeno prvič.

programme.desc: A Parisian couple moves to the countryside with their two children, convinced that they have found their dream home: a house with a large garden right next to the forest and far from the hustle and bustle of the city. The idyll soon turns into chaos when they discover that the surroundings are not so innocent. There is a long-standing hunting ground there, to which the locals are extremely attached. A series of events that begins as a few awkward meetings soon grows into a real war between the newcomers and the natives, in which there is no shortage of petty sabotage, tricks and funny confrontations. Idila pa se kmalu sprevrže v moro, ko odkrijeta, da okolica ni tako nedolžna. Tam je namreč dolgoletno lovišče, na katero so domačini izjemno navezani. programme.desc: R: Žnidaršič Urška... On Friday, May 24, 2024, on the occasion of their 40th anniversary, the legendary Slovenian punk rock band Niet made a triumphant return to Ljubljana's Križanke. The sold-out concert thrilled the 3,300-strong crowd. She accompanied in unison the almost two-hour performance of the band, which was formed in 1983. Their friends also paid tribute to Niet with musical performances: the string quartet Vijolica, singer Severa Gjurin, keyboardist Primož Trebec, Kombinatke, Primož Alič (Zablujena generacija), Gregor Strasbergar Štras (Mrfy), Manca Trampuš (Koala Voice) and Tomislav Jovanović Tokac (Day D). / R: Žnidaršič Urška... Ta je v en glas spremljala skoraj dveurni nastop zasedbe, ki je nastala leta 1983. Nietom so se z glasbenimi nastopi poklonili tudi njihovi prijatelji: godalni kvartet Vijolice, pevka Severa Gjurin, klaviaturist Primož Trebec, Kombinatke, Primož Alič (Zablujena generacija), Gregor Strasbergar Štras (Mrfy), Manca Trampuš (Koala Voice) in Tomislav Jovanović Tokac (Dan D).

programme.desc: The architect decided to buy an apartment in Trieste because life in the seaside city is close to her, and in addition, real estate prices there are more bearable than in Slovenia. From an old apartment with furniture from the 70s of the last century, she has created a bright, colorful home with a unique atmosphere through renovation. Iz postaranega stanovanja z opremo iz 70. let prejšnjega stoletja je s prenovo ustvarila svetel, barvit dom z edinstvenim vzdušjem.Znova se odpravljamo v Zeleni raj nad Litijo, kjer nas bo lastnik Miha Kos popeljal skozi slikovit rastlinski park na 600 metrih nadmorske višine. Na sončnem pobočju nam bo razkril pomen vodnih motivov, predstavil bogato zbirko kaktusov in izpostavil rastlinske posebnosti, ki parku dajejo edinstven čar.

From Klanc to Klanc, cycling challenge with Tadej Pogačar, reportage / S Klanca v klanc, kolesarski izziv s Tadejem Pogačarjem, reportaža
programme.desc: At the end of a new exceptional season, in which he won the race in France for the fourth time and added the titles of world and European champion, the world's number one cyclist set a special challenge to the fans: to compete with him on the climb from his hometown Klanc pri Komenda to Plaža na Krvavac. The "home" slope on Krvavec is an important part of his preparations for the season. The response was extraordinary: cyclists from as many as 36 countries participated in the first edition of Pogačar's challenge. Cycling with the best in the world is simply a priceless experience. / Prvi kolesar sveta je za konec nove izjemne sezone, v kateri je že četrtič osvojil dirko po Franciji ter temu dodal še naslova svetovnega in evropskega prvaka, navijačem postavil poseben izziv: da se z njim pomerijo na vzponu od njegovega domačega Klanca pri Komendi do Plaže na Krvavcu. »Hišni« klanec na Krvavec je pomemben del njegovih priprav na sezono. Odziv je bil izjemen: na prvi izvedbi Pogačarjevega izziva so bili kolesarji iz kar 36 držav. Kolesariti z najboljšim na svetu je enostavno neprecenljivo doživetje.

programme.title: Schonbrunn Summer Concert 2025, Vienna Philharmonic, Piotr Beczała and Tugan Sokiev, Mon. / Poletni koncert iz Schonbrunna 2025, Dunajski filharmoniki, Piotr Beczała in Tugan Sokijev, pon.
programme.desc: The summer concert in the picturesque castle gardens of Schonbrunn Palace in Vienna is one of the world's most popular outdoor music events. Schonbrunn Park is otherwise a protected area and is usually closed in the evening; it is opened to the public only once a year, for the summer concert of the Vienna Philharmonic, which has been playing there since 2004. This time the conductor is in the hands of Tugan Sokijev, and the Vienna Boys' Choir, founded by Slovenian bishop, choirmaster and composer Jurij Slatkonja, also performs for the first time at the concert. The famous Polish tenor Piotr Bezcała will perform as a soloist, and the concert program once again offers popular classical music from different eras. / Poletni koncert v slikovitih grajskih vrtovih dvorca Schonbrunn na Dunaju je eden izmed najbolj priljubljenih svetovnih glasbenih dogodkov na prostem. Park Schonbrunn je sicer zaščiteno območje in je zvečer navadno zaprt; za javnost ga odprejo le enkrat letno, za poletni koncert Dunajskih filharmonikov, ki tam igrajo že vse od leta 2004. Taktirka je tokrat v rokah Tugana Sokijeva, na koncertu pa prvič nastopa tudi Zbor dunajskih dečkov, ki ga je ustanovil slovenski škof, zborovodja in skladatelj Jurij Slatkonja. Kot solist bo nastopil sloviti poljski tenorist Piotr Bezcała, program koncerta pa vnovič ponuja priljubljeno klasično glasbo različnih obdobij.

programme.title: Asia: The Frozen North, British documentary series, 3/7 / Azija: Zamrznjeni sever, britanska dokumentarna serija, 3/7
programme.sub-title: Asia; Dokumentarna serija Azija raziskuje izjemno naravo in naravna čudesa največje celine na Zemlji. Popelje nas skozi najosupljivejše azijske pokrajine – od najvišjih vrhov sveta v Himalaji do džungel Bornea, od polarne divjine Sibirije do koralnih mo
programme.desc: Part 3: The Frozen North In North Asia, life defies extreme conditions. In Lake Baikal, seal pups must learn to swim under the ice at an early age. Hokkaido's hot springs shelter dancing cranes. In Tibet, for a lone Himalayan wolf, every hunt is a test of endurance, and in Japan, bats hibernate right under the snow. In Arctic Russia, starving polar bears wait longer and longer on desolate shores for the sea to freeze again. ASIA / Great Britain / 2024 / Director: Henry M Mix. / 3. del: Zamrznjeni severV severni Aziji življenje kljubuje skrajnim razmeram. V Bajkalskem jezeru se morajo tjulnji mladiči že zgodaj naučiti plavati pod ledom. Topli vrelci na Hokaidu dajejo zavetje plešočim žerjavom. V Tibetu je za osamljenega himalajskega volka vsak lov preizkušnja vzdržljivosti, na Japonskem pa netopirji prezimujejo kar pod snegom. V arktični Rusiji sestradani severni medvedi na pustih obalah čedalje dlje čakajo, da bo morje spet zaledenelo. ASIA / Velika Britanija / 2024 / Režija: Henry M Mix.

programme.title: Fishermans Friends / Fishermans Friends
programme.desc: London executives from a record company arrive in a remote Cornish village to celebrate a bachelor party, where they meet a group of fishermen who sing sea songs. As a result of a joke, one of the executives stays in the village to try to get a contract with the group of singers for the record company. Optimistic British comedy (pure feel good) starring ten fishermen from Cornwall and the non-professional folk group of which they are a part. Based (quite loosely) on a true story, the film's cast is led by James Purefoy (Momentum, Altered Carbon, The Following, Roma), Daniel Mays (1917, Infiltrado) and Tuppence Middleton (War of the Currents, Double Identity: Jaque at MI5). / Uns executius londinencs duna discogràfica arriben a un poble remot de Cornualla per celebrar un comiat de solter, on coneixen un grup de pescadors que canten cançons de mar. A resultes duna broma, un dels executius es queda al poble per mirar daconseguir un contracte amb el grup de cantants per a la discogràfica.Optimista comèdia britànica (pur feel good) protagonitzada per deu pescadors de Cornualla i el grup de folk no professional del qual formen part. Basada (bastant lliurement) en una història real, encapçalen el repartiment de la pel·lícula James Purefoy (Momentum, Altered Carbon, The Following, Roma), Daniel Mays (1917, Infiltrado) i Tuppence Middleton (La guerra dels corrents, Doble identidad: Jaque al MI5).

programme.title: The decision / La decisio
programme.desc: A woman suffering from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis decides to end her suffering through euthanasia with the help of her husband. However, the decision brings with it a series of conflicts. A truly luxurious cast headed by Susan Sarandon (Death Penalty), Kate Winslet (The Reader (El lector)), Mia Wasikowska (Stoker), Sam Neill (The Piano) and Lindsay Duncan (An Exceptional Gift) star in this drama with family relationships as the center of the plot and euthanasia as a backdrop that does not lack a sense of humor. Directed by Roger Michell (Notting Hill) and written by Christian Torpe, this moving and tender story shows the last family reunion of a woman with a terminal illness who has decided to end her life. The protagonist, who wants to die with dignity before her physical deterioration leaves her totally invalid, will have to deal with the incomprehension of some members of her family. / Una dona que pateix esclerosi lateral amiotròfica decideix acabar amb el seu sofriment per mitjà de leutanàsia amb lajuda del seu marit. No obstant, la decisio porta amb si una sèrie de conflictes.Un repartiment dautèntic luxe encapçalat per Susan Sarandon (Pena de mort), Kate Winslet (The Reader (El lector)), Mia Wasikowska (Stoker), Sam Neill (El piano) i Lindsay Duncan (Un do excepcional) protagonitza aquest drama amb les relacions familiars com a centre de la trama i leutanàsia com a telo de fons al qual no li falta sentit de lhumor.Dirigida per Roger Michell (Notting Hill) i escrita per Christian Torpe, aquesta commovedora i tendra història mostra lúltima reunio familiar duna dona amb una malaltia terminal que ha decidit posar fi a la seva vida. La protagonista, que vol morir amb dignitat abans que la seva deterioracio física la deixi totalment invàlida, haurà de bregar amb la incomprensio dalguns membres de la seva família.

programme.title: Murder in the north / Asesinato en el norte
programme.desc: In the area called Devil's Island in Lubeck there are plots with beautiful gardens, but when Anke and Gerd Siebert's robotic lawnmower escapes and stumbles upon a corpse on the neighbors' plot, this idyllic peace disappears. / A la zona anomenada Illa del Diable de Lubeck hi ha unes parcel·les amb uns jardins preciosos, però quan el robot tallagespa de lAnke i en Gerd Siebert sescapa i es topa amb un cadàver a la parcel·la dels veïns, aquesta pau idíl·lica desapareix.

programme.desc: The Ciudad de Cádiz Sports Complex hosts a new edition of this international judo tournament, in which they compete in the mixed team modality. programme.title: W100 Les Franqueses del VallesSemifinal 1 / W100 Les Franqueses del VallesSemifinal 1
programme.desc: The Els Gorchs Tennis Club hosts the ITF W100 in Les Franqueses del Vallès. From October 13 to 19, the Catalan town is the setting for this women's hard court tournament. programme.desc: Surfing is a very spectacular modality, both for those who see it and for those who practice it. programme.desc: The Supersport 300 World Championship is a competition that shares the European calendar and venues with the World Superbike Championship. There are eight grand prizes. programme.desc: Marie's sister comes to visit and helps Marie choose a color for the walls in the house and they explore the city together. programme.title: Race Across the World Sverige / Race Across the World Sverige
programme.desc: Now it's only hitchhiking and the teams are nervous about how it will go. Tobbe and Anders visit a Thai tattoo studio. programme.title: Forrest Gump / Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Forrest Gump tells the story of his incredible life in this dramatic comedy that became a worldwide success. Forrest has been a celebrated athlete, war hero and millionaire. In spite of everything that has happened to him, he has never been able to relax the male game to his childhood friend Jenny. / Forrest Gump berattar historien om sitt otroliga liv i denna dramakomedi som blev en varldssucce. Forrest har varit firad idrottsman, krigshjalte och miljonar. Trots allt som har hant har han aldrig kunnat slappa karleken till barndomsvannen Jenny.

programme.title: National Lampoons European Vacation / National Lampoons European Vacation

programme.desc: Marie is passionate about interior design and Bill is the home carpenter who is always renovating. They are passionate house lovers and have renovated four houses in ten years. Now they move to Hoganas and a house that Marie dreamed about and longed for. But despite their vast experience, not everything goes as planned. Nu flyttar de till Hoganas och ett hus som Marie dromt om och langtat efter. Men trots deras stora erfarenhet går inte allting som planerat. Det blir ett provningens år for hela familjen.

programme.desc: Nicke is hosted by noise and silence researcher Outi Ampuja. She has researched noise, the history of noise and the quality of our sound environment. Some of the people who visited the open house at Stromso at the beginning of the summer also got their say: Which is the loudest sound there is, which is the most pleasant and can it be too quiet? In the kitchen, Julien and Elin offer mussels that will convince even the biggest mussel skeptic. En del av manniskorna som besokte oppet hus på Stromso i borjan av sommaren får också saga sitt: Vilket ar det varsta ljudet som finns, vilket ar det mest behagliga och kan det bli for tyst? I koket bjuder Julien och Elin på musslor som fralser aven den storsta musselskeptikern. Hanna och Elin visar hur du forvandlar dina skinny jeans till vida jeans.

programme.title: First date / Forsta dejten
programme.desc: In addition to a charming teenage couple on a speed date, we meet 62-year-old Stefan, who is a good dancer, but even though he meets ladies on the dance floor, he doesn't want to "hunt at his workplace". After several years of being single, he now longs for twoness. Lena, 62, has stayed in the safe corner of the home for far too long, which has made her feel a little rusty when it comes to dating. When the cautious couple sit down at the bar, it turns out that not only do they have like-minded values, they're pretty much neighbors too, but is it enough for them both to dare to say yes to a second date? Elias, 17, from Gothenburg longs for manhood and already knows what his future child will be called. 17-year-old Molly hasn't planned quite as far ahead, she's more focused on the ogon color of her date. If it turns out that the color is wrong, it can be very problematic with the ogon contact. / Forutom ett charmigt tonårspar på speeddejt moter vi 62-åriga Stefan som ar en duktig dansor, men trots att han traffar damer på dansgolvet vill han inte ”jaga på sin arbetsplats”. Efter flera år som singel langtar han nu efter tvåsamhet. Lena, 62, har stannat i hemmets trygga vrå alldeles for lange vilket gjort att hon kanner sig lite rostig nar det kommer till dejting. Nar det forsiktiga paret satter sig i baren visar det sig inte bara att de har likasinnade varderingar, de ar i stort sett grannar också, men racker det for att de båda ska våga saga ja till en andra dejt? Elias, 17, från Goteborg langtar efter karlek och vet redan vad hans framtida barn ska heta. 17-åriga Molly har inte planerat riktigt lika långt fram i tiden, hon ar mer fokuserad på sin dejts ogonfarg. programme.title: Innocence: opera by Kaija Saariaho / Innocence: opera av Kaija Saariaho
programme.desc: Finnish composer Kaija Saariaho's (1952-2023) opera Innocence took both audiences and critics by storm at its world premiere in Aix-en-Provence in 2021. The libretto, written by renowned author Sofi Oksanen, takes place in two timelines and depicts the shocking account of a school shooting. We hear the London Symphony Orchestra and soloists such as Magdalena Kožena and Sandrine Piau under the direction of conductor Susanna Malkki. The 2025 edition of the world's biggest prize for classical music - the Birgit Nilsson Prize - is awarded to the opera festival in Aix-en-Provence. The award justification emphasizes the festival's outstanding artistic achievements, with special recognition for the 2021 staging of the opera Innocence. The prize will be awarded on 21 October. / Den finlandska kompositoren Kaija Saariahos (1952-2023) opera Innocence tog både publik och kritiker med storm vid sin varldspremiar i Aix-en-Provence 2021. Librettot, skrivet av den beromda forfattaren Sofi Oksanen, utspelas i två tidsplan och skildrar den skakande berattelsen om en skolskjutning. Vi hor London Symphony Orchestra och solister som Magdalena Kožena och Sandrine Piau under ledning av dirigenten Susanna Malkki. 2025 års upplaga av varldens storsta pris for klassisk musik - Birgit Nilsson Prize - tilldelas operafestivalen i Aix-en-Provence. I prismotiveringen betonas festivalens enastående konstnarliga prestationer, med ett sarskilt erkannande for 2021 års uppsattning av just operan Innocence. Priset delas ut den 21 oktober.

One day, the gang receives an assignment from a local gangster boss; they must enroll in the so-called Solskolan because in the tunnels under the school it is rumored that there is a great treasure buried. In secret, Ali and his friends will now try to dig up the treasure, but it turns out to be easier said than done. / Ett drama om tolvårige gatubarnet Ali och hans tre vanner som via enklare jobb och småbrott kampar for att overleva och forsorja sina familjer. En dag får ganget ett uppdrag av en lokal gangsterboss; de ska skriva in sig i den så kallade Solskolan for i tunnlarna under skolan ryktas att det finns en stor skatt begravd. I hemlighet ska nu Ali och hans vanner forsoka grava fram skatten men det visar sig vara lattare sagt an gjort.

programme.title: The cowboy, the king and the mountain / Cowboyen, kungen och fjallet
programme.desc: Arvid is a man with many irons in the fire, but with somewhat limited impulse control. Now he wants to create Norway's own Mount Rushmore, with an image of Norway's king carved into the mountain. Sounds impossible it may seem, but not for Arvid. In this documentary series, we get a closer look at Arvid's life. A man who is true to himself and walks his own path. (Norway, 2022) / Arvid ar en man med många jarn i elden, men med något begransad impulskontroll. Nu vill han skapa Norges eget Mount Rushmore, med en avbild av Norges kung uthuggen i fjallet. Låter omojligt kan tyckas, men inte for Arvid. I denna dokumentarserie kommer vi Arvid nara inpå livet. En man som ar sann mot sig sjalv och går sin egen vag. (Norge, 2022)

programme.title: In the glove of you / I vantan på dig
programme.desc: In Billna's footsteps, a child in the bathroom and Elina and Janne can probably call themselves parents. Michaela has barely slept in a month and Janina thinks it's her last baby. But you should never say never. / I Billnas fods ett barn i badrummet och Elina och Janne får antligen kalla sig foraldrar. Michaela har knappt sovit på en månad och Janina tror att det har ar hennes sista bebis. Men man ska aldrig saga aldrig.

programme.title: Rally WC, Central European Rally / Rally-VM, Centraleuropeiska rallyt
programme.desc: Oliver Solberg has already secured the WC title in WRC2, but in the main class the fight for the overall victory is tough ahead of the Central European rally, which crosses three different countries. Expert: PG Andersson. / Oliver Solberg har redan sakrat VM-titeln i WRC2, men i huvudklassen ar kampen om totalsegern stenhård infor det Centraleuropeiska rallyt, som kors i tre olika lander. Sebastien Ogier ar två poang fore Elfyn Evans. Även Kalle Rovanpera har chansen att blanda sig i kampen. Vi sander ett sammandrag. Kommentator: Maria Wallberg. Expert: PG Andersson.

programme.title: Hockey pictures / Hockeybilder
programme.desc: Short archive. Leif Boork is a woodcutter in Djurgården and known for his unusual methods. Artur Ringart follows the future confederation captain during a match in 1982. / Kort arkivet. Leif Boork ar tranare i Djurgården och kand for sina ovanliga metoder. Artur Ringart foljer den blivande forbundskaptenen under en match 1982.

programme.title: Nature of the World: The Wild Life of the Panda / Varldens natur: Pandans vilda liv
programme.desc: Most pandas are born in captivity. In China to become candidates and representatives of the country to the world. But a few pandas have been given a different task... Follow a panda's journey from cradle all the way to freedom over three years. What is the wild world he will face? / De flesta pandor fods i fångenskap. I Kina for att bli kandisar och representanter for landet varlden over. Men några få pandor har fått en annan uppgift... Folj med på en pandas resa från fodsel hela vagen till frihet under tre år. Vilken ar den vilda varld han kommer att mota?

programme.title: Babel / Babel
programme.desc: Nina Waha digs into her father's past in Major Whirlwind. The author panel with Aris Fioretos, Sofia Ronnow Pessah and Johannes Anyuru advises on the books that instill hope for old age. In the middle of the program, the children take over the Babel studio, and there will be a special episode about children's literature for the reading holiday! The presenters Minou Lindholm and Sami Fagerstrom Erfan from TSM find out which book is the world's laziest and there will be book tips from IJustWantToBeCool and Smilla Holmberg and others. Yumi And Tomu, Isabelle Riddez and Måns Nilsson are guests in the studio. The panel with i.a. Einar from Tordyveln flies in the dusk tips about bucks that should be made into a movie. / Nina Waha graver i sin pappas forflutna i Major Virvelvind. Forfattarpanelen med Aris Fioretos, Sofia Ronnow Pessah och Johannes Anyuru tipsar om bockerna som ingjuter hopp om ålderdomen. Mitt i programmet tar barnen over Babelstudion, och det blir ett specialavsnitt om barnlitteratur infor laslovet! Programledarna Minou Lindholm och Sami Fagerstrom Erfan från TSM tar reda på vilken bok som ar varldens laskigaste och det blir boktips från IJustWantToBeCool och Smilla Holmberg m.fl. Yumi And Tomu, Isabelle Riddez och Måns Nilsson ar gaster i studion. Panelen med bl.a. Einar från Tordyveln flyger i skymningen tipsar om bocker som borde bli film.

programme.desc: In 2025, the eternally young Pippi Longstocking turns 80. At Olniansky Tekst, a small publishing house in southern Sweden, they have translated Pippi into Yiddish and now reach a global audience. Nikolaj Olniansky talks about the publisher's work and his own foray into Yiddish. / 2025 fyller den evigt unga Pippi Långstrump 80 år. Hosts Hannamari Hoikkala and Nicke Alden guide you to unusual tourist spots, unique attractions and fascinating personalities around Finland. (Finland, 2020). / Mystiska grottor i Åbo. Inte långt utanfor Åbo centrum ligger Luolavuoris grotta, en sevardhet som ar obekant aven for stor del av lokalbefolkningen. Grottan som under århundradenas gång sags ha harbargerat såval rovare som rymlingar ar idag ett resmål for besokare som agnar sig grottkrypning och geocaching. Programledarna Hannamari Hoikkala och Nicke Alden guidar till ovantade turistparlor, unika attraktioner och fascinerande personligheter runt omkring i Finland. (Finland, 2020).

programme.desc: Riggs is tough, efficient and within the police force known as a deadly weapon. Murtaugh is the opposite of Riggs. A devoted family man who prefers not to take any risks. Ben Campbell tries to finance his studies when he is joined by the most talented students at MIT and involved in a daring coup against Las Vegas casinos. / Ben Campbell forsoker finansiera sina studier nar han blir varvad av de mest begåvade studenterna på MIT och delaktig i en våghalsig kupp mot Las Vegas kasinon.

programme.desc: It has been six years since the century's most fabled wedding between Grace Kelly and Prince Rainier III of Monaco and Grace has fully stepped into the role of mother and dutiful wife. Madde looks back on her chaotic upbringing and rejoices in typical family things that she has never been a part of before. / Julen ar antligen har och Natalie har massor att stå i. Huset ska stadas, julklapparna ska slås in och all mat ska lagas. Hos Julia och Milan ar det också kampigt, men av en helt annan anledning. Milan har fått vinterkraksjukan och eventuellt kan det bidra till att de kommer missa den stora pepparkakshus-byggartavlingen hemma hos farmor. Madde ser tillbaka på sin stokiga uppvaxt och gladjs åt typiska familjegrejer som hon aldrig varit en del av tidigare.

Slamsugaren Magnus tar sig an en pumpgrop, ett riskfyllt uppdrag på grund av alla farliga gaser som bildas.

programme.title: Young Mothers / Unga Mammor
programme.desc: Christmas is probably over and Natalie is completely tired of all the Christmas stuff and Christmas-sped children. The daycare is busy and she is busy trying to entertain three little girls. Mileah has turned one month old and Madde talks about how she has changed their lives. / Julen ar antligen over och Natalie ar helt slut av allt julstok och julspeedade barn. Dagiset håller stangt och hon har fullt upp med att forsoka roa tre småtjejer. Mileah har hunnit bli en månad gammal och Madde berattar om hur hon har forandrat deras liv.

programme.title: Young Mothers / Unga Mammor
programme.desc: Beauty-loving Lina has long dreamed of doing fillers in her lips, and now is probably the time. She is extremely afraid of being smart and is unsure if she will be able to handle it. For the first time since Mileah was born, Madde and Isaac are going out to eat at a restaurant completely alone. Isaac is worried that his parents will not be good enough babysitters and finds it difficult to let go of control. Natalie goes to a dog show in Goteborg and Julia and hers win tracks in tin to see if they can get any hint of what they need next year. / Skonhetsalskande Lina har lange dromt om att gora fillers i lapparna och nu ar det antligen dags. Hon ar enormt radd for smarta och ar osaker på om hon kommer klara av det. For forsta gången sen Mileah foddes ska Madde och Isaac ut och ata på restaurang helt sjalva. Isaac ar orolig over att hans foraldrar inte ska vara tillrackligt bra barnvakter och har svårt att slappa kontrollen. Natalie åker på hundutstallning till Goteborg och Julia och hennes vanner spår i tenn for att se om de kan få någon hint av vad som vantar dem nasta år.

programme.desc: Jack supports Nick after a confrontation with Juno. Katya confides in her husband about Vika, leaving her torn before the launch of her swimwear line. programme.desc: Theresa Osborne was left by her husband and dedicates her life to her son Jason and to her work as a researcher. During one holiday, while he is jogging on the beach, he finds a bottle with a letter inside addressed to a woman named Catherine. The content is so touching that the temptation to trace the author is very strong. The Chicago Tribune wrote an article about it and many readers wrote to the newspaper to find out more. Theresa manages to identify a place and a name, that of Garret Blake, a boat manufacturer who lives with his father Dodge. A friendship is born between Theresa and Garret but the figure of his wife is very present and the woman returns to Chicago. When she invites Garret to join her at her house, the man discovers the bottle and sees the article published in the newspaper; he realizes that Theresa found the message, believing it to be written by him, when in reality it was written by Catherine. / Theresa Osborne e stata lasciata dal marito e dedica la sua vita al figlio Jason e al proprio lavoro da ricercatrice. Il contenuto e cosi toccante che la tentazione di risalire allautore e molto forte. Il Chicago Tribune ne fa un articolo e molti lettori scrivono al giornale per saperne di piu. Theresa riesce ad individuare una localita ed un nome, quello di Garret Blake, un fabbricante di barche che vive con il padre Dodge.Tra Theresa e Garret nasce una simpatia ma la figura della moglie e molto presente e la donna torna a Chicago. Quando invita Garret a raggiungerla nella sua casa, luomo scopre la bottiglia e vede larticolo pubblicato sul giornale; capisce che Theresa ha trovato il messaggio, credendolo scritto da lui, mentre in realta e stato scritto da Catherine.

programme.title: Heidi / Heidi
programme.desc: Mr. Traber had a good idea for the autumn festival: Rico will open the celebrations with a melody on his violin. The little Italian is happy, Heidi too, but not Teresa. She is offended because normally it is William who opens the dance by playing the alphorn. This is intolerable and, to avoid William's humiliation, Teresa decides to steal Rico's violin. He succeeds, but after a chase through the woods, Rico, Heidi and Peter find the broken instrument. Rico wants to respond in kind but Heidi has another idea and needs her grandfather's help. That evening, at the beginning of the party, Teresa is happy to see William ready to play the alphorn as usual. However, Rico arrives and takes out his violin, recently repaired by his grandfather. Accompanied by the old man with his harmonica, Rico begins a lively tune. / Il signor Traber ha avuto una buona idea per la festa dautunno: Rico aprirà i festeggiamenti con una melodia sul suo violino. Il piccolo italiano è contento, Heidi anche, ma non Teresa. Lei è offesa perche normalmente è William che apre il ballo suonando il corno alpino. Questo è intollerabile e, per evitare lumiliazione di William, Teresa decide di rubare il violino di Rico. Ci riesce, ma dopo un inseguimento nel bosco, Rico, Heidi e Peter trovano lo strumento rotto. Rico vuole rispondere a tono ma Heidi ha unaltra idea e ha bisogno dellaiuto del nonno. Quella sera, allinizio della festa, Teresa si rallegra nel vedere William pronto a suonare il corno alpino come al solito. Tuttavia, Rico arriva e tira fuori il suo violino, appena riparato dal nonno. Accompagnato dal vecchio con la sua armonica, Rico inizia una melodia vivace.

programme.title: Math Explosion - Mismatched Socks / Math Explosion - Calzini spaiati
programme.desc: Math Explosion - Mathematical experiments and curiosities / Math Explosion - Esperimenti e curiosità matematiche

programme.title: Albert's Garden - Why do sharks attack? / Il giardino di Albert - Perche gli squali attaccano?
programme.desc: Three deadly attacks in less than a year in the Red Sea. A mystery that shocks tourists, biologists and authorities. Dramas that, without a doubt, leave indelible traces. The documentary proposed today by Albert's garden investigates the causes behind these rare but disturbing events, revealing a mix of factors: warming waters, tourist overcrowding, intensive fishing and hungry sharks pushing ever closer to the coast. With exclusive images, direct testimonies and scientific analyses, the film takes us between the coral reefs of Egypt, the beaches of Florida and the Australian coasts, where the coexistence between man and shark is increasingly delicate. But sharks are not bloodthirsty monsters. They are ancient predators, essential for the balance of the oceans. And perhaps, rather than fear them, we should really learn to know them. A compelling story that mixes biology, ecology and technology, and which forces us to admit perhaps the most obvious thing: we are the ones invading their world! / Tre attacchi mortali in meno di un anno nel Mar Rosso. Un mistero che scuote turisti, biologi e autorità. Drammi che, senza alcun dubbio, lasciano tracce indelebili. Il documentario proposto oggi dal giardino di Albert indaga le cause dietro questi eventi rari ma inquietanti, svelando un intreccio di fattori: riscaldamento delle acque, sovraffollamento turistico, pesca intensiva e squali affamati che si spingono sempre più vicino alla costa. Con immagini esclusive, testimonianze dirette e analisi scientifiche, il filmato ci porta tra le barriere coralline dellEgitto, le spiagge della Florida e le coste australiane, dove la convivenza tra uomo e squalo è sempre più delicata. Ma gli squali non sono mostri sanguinari. Sono predatori antichi, essenziali per lequilibrio degli oceani. E forse, più che temerli, dovremmo imparare a conoscerli davvero. Un racconto avvincente che mescola biologia, ecologia e tecnologia, e che ci costringe ad ammettere la cosa forse più evidente: siamo noi ad invadere il loro mondo!

programme.title: Paganini / Paganini
programme.desc: An instrument that crosses genres and is extraordinarily versatile, capable of shining both as a solo voice and as a discreet companion, the piano will be the protagonist of the Paganini episode broadcast on Sunday 19 October at 10.30am on RSI LA1. With two different contributions, the program will explore the jazz declination of the instrument, between regional roots and international horizons. The starting point is a significant anniversary: ​​twenty years ago Riccardo Garzoni, one of the greatest Ticino jazz pianists and one of the few to have gained prominence on the international scene, left us prematurely. To remember him, one of his performances recorded for the RSI Nautilus broadcast in 1988 will be shown again, in a trio with drummer Alan Nelson and double bass player Peter Bockius. Of a completely different generation and with a different musical language, Erroll Garner was one of the most famous jazz pianists ever, capable of achieving a notoriety comparable to that of pop and rock stars during his lifetime. His story was recently told by the Swiss director Georges Gachot in the documentary Misty - The story of Erroll Garner: a work which, in addition to enhancing his inventiveness and musical energy, restores the deep and intimate emotions of his private and family experience. - Riccardo Garzoni Trio - Misty - The story of Erroll Garner / Strumento trasversale ai generi e straordinariamente versatile, capace di brillare sia come voce solista sia come compagno discreto, il pianoforte sarà protagonista della puntata di Paganini in onda domenica 19 ottobre alle 10.30 su RSI LA1. Con due diversi contributi, la trasmissione esplorerà la declinazione jazzistica dello strumento, tra radici regionali e orizzonti internazionali. Il punto di partenza è una ricorrenza significativa: ventanni fa ci lasciava prematuramente Riccardo Garzoni, tra i maggiori pianisti jazz ticinesi e tra i pochi ad aver conquistato rilievo anche sulla scena internazionale. Per ricordarlo, verrà riproposta una sua esibizione registrata per la trasmissione RSI Nautilus nel 1988, in trio con il batterista Alan Nelson e il contrabbassista Peter Bockius. Di tuttaltra generazione e con un linguaggio musicale differente, Erroll Garner è stato invece uno dei pianisti jazz più celebri di sempre, capace di raggiungere in vita una notorietà paragonabile a quella delle star del pop e del rock. La sua storia è stata recentemente raccontata dal regista svizzero Georges Gachot nel documentario Misty - La storia di Erroll Garner: un lavoro che, oltre a esaltarne linventiva e lenergia musicale, restituisce le emozioni profonde e intime del suo vissuto privato e famigliare. - Riccardo Garzoni Trio - Misty - La storia di Erroll Garner

It tells about current events, but it does so with a direct, no-frills style, trying to capture the public's attention. / Il Telegiornale offre al pubblico la sintesi ragionata delle principali notizie del giorno, delle immagini che contano, dei temi che suscitano interesse. Vi si racconta lattualità, ma lo si fa con uno stile diretto, senza fronzoli, cercando di cogliere lattenzione del pubblico.

programme.title: Stories / Storie
programme.desc: A sensorial and poetic journey in Cappadocia, guided by those who cannot see but know how to look deeper. Igor and Barbara, visually impaired, lead us on a unique experience between underground cities, ancient traditions and a spectacular hot air balloon trip. Through their daily gestures and the emotions experienced, we rediscover the beauty of the small things that are often forgotten. A documentary where the gaze becomes listening, speech, touch, scent and memory and the protagonists become narrators of their own world. A documentary by Mirko Aretini / Un viaggio sensoriale e poetico in Cappadocia, guidato da chi non può vedere ma sa guardare più a fondo. Igor e Barbara, ipovedenti, ci conducono in un’esperienza unica tra città sotterranee, antiche tradizioni ed uno spettacolare viaggio in mongolfiera. Attraverso i loro gesti quotidiani e le emozioni vissute, riscopriamo la bellezza delle piccole cose spesso dimenticate. Un documentario dove lo sguardo diventa ascolto, parola, tocco, profumo e memoria e i protagonisti diventano narratori del proprio mondo.Un documentario di Mirko Aretini

programme.title: Yukon Mission - Seventh episode / Missione Yukon - Settimo episodio
programme.desc: An unforgettable First of August: it is the last project of the Tribe on the other side of the world before returning home. After a month of adventures in the wild nature, the time has come for the two French-speaking families to leave the North-West territories. But what will our heroes leave in the endless forests of the Yukon and what will they take with them to Switzerland? We will find out together in the seventh and final episode of Mission Yukon. / Un Primo dAgosto indimenticabile: è lultimo progetto della Tribù dellaltro capo del mondo prima di tornare a casa. Dopo un mese di avventure nella natura selvaggia per le due famiglie romande è infatti giunto il momento di lasciare i territori del Nord-Ovest. Ma i nostri eroi cosa lasceranno nelle sterminate foreste dello Yukon e cosa porteranno con se in Svizzera? Lo scopriremo insieme nella settima e ultima puntata di Missione Yukon.

programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.desc: Fumes, odors and unpleasant noises are the symbol of a difficult coexistence between the PAMP refinery in Castel S. Pietro and the inhabitants of the Gorla district. The matter has been going on for years and continues to raise complaints, doubts and requests for solutions. A recent question in the Grand Council reignites the case and asks for intervention. Falò reportage among the citizens' concerns, the timely responses of the company managers, the feedback from the Municipality and the Canton. / Fumi, odori e rumori sgradevoli sono il simbolo di una convivenza difficile tra la raffineria PAMP di Castel S. Pietro e gli abitanti del quartiere di Gorla. La vicenda si protrae da anni e continua a suscitare lamentele, dubbi e richieste di soluzioni. Una recente interrogazione in Gran Consiglio riaccende il caso e chiede dintervenire. Reportage di Falò tra le preoccupazioni dei cittadini, le puntuali risposte dei dirigenti dellazienda, i riscontri del Comune e del Cantone.

programme.title: Treasures of the World - Merida - Waterways and more - Spain / Tesori del mondo - Merida - Vie dacqua e daltro - Spagna
programme.sub-title: Merida - Vie dacqua e daltro - Spagna
programme.desc: Merida is a Spanish municipality of 54,893 inhabitants, capital of the autonomous community of Extremadura. By population it is the third largest city in the region after Cáceres and Badajoz itself. It is located on the right bank of the Guadiana at 217 meters above sea level. and it is one of the cities in Spain richest in Roman monuments, so much so that it is called Spanish Rome. It is 60 km from Badajoz and 70 from Cáceres. Its economy is based partly on agriculture, partly on industry and services and on tourism thanks to its monumental heritage and the various events organized. Merida is an episcopal and university seat. / Merida è un comune spagnolo di 54.893 abitanti capoluogo della comunità autonoma dellEstremadura. Per popolazione è la terza città della regione dopo Cáceres e Badajoz stessa. È posta sulla riva destra della Guadiana a 217 metri s.l.m. ed è una delle città della Spagna più ricche di monumenti romani tanto da essere chiamata la Roma spagnola. Dista 60 km da Badajoz e 70 da Cáceres. La sua economia è fondata in parte sull agricoltura, in parte sullindustria e sui servizi e sul turismo grazie al patrimonio monumentale di cui è dotata e alle varie manifestazioni organizzate. Merida è sede vescovile e universitaria.

programme.title: The Karate Kid - To win tomorrow / The Karate Kid - Per vincere domani
programme.desc: Timeless cult film from the 80s with Ralph Macchio and Pat Morita. A boy bullied by school bullies is taught the art of karate by a wise Japanese master. / Intramontabile film-culto degli anni 80 con Ralph Macchio e Pat Morita. Un ragazzo vessato dai bulli della scuola viene istruito da un saggio maestro giapponese allarte del karate.

programme.title: 007 - A waterfall of diamonds / 007 - Una cascata di diamanti
programme.desc: Commander James Bond, aka agent 007 of the English secret service, has just completed a difficult mission and is immediately entrusted with the task of discovering the organizers and reasons behind a mysterious hoard of diamonds, which threatens to upset the market. Having assumed the identity of Peter Franks, one of the gang's couriers, Bond does not take long to identify its leader, the beautiful Tiffany Case, whose organisation, however, has for some time been suffering attacks from unknown adversaries, who kill the smugglers and take possession of the diamonds. Having become Tiffany, to whom he revealed his identity, his ally, Bond discovers, after having twice avoided being killed, that the diamonds stolen from Case's organization have ended up in a space laboratory, and used in the construction of a satellite, which is about to be launched into orbit. / Il comandante James Bond, alias agente 007 del servizio segreto inglese, ha appena portato a termine una difficile missione, che subito, gli viene affidato il compito di scoprire gli organizzatori e le ragioni di una misteriosa incetta di diamanti, che minaccia di sconvolgere il mercato. Assunta lidentità di Peter Franks, uno dei corrieri della banda, Bond non tarda a individuarne il capo, la bella Tiffany Case, la cui organizzazione, pero, sta da qualche tempo subendo gli attacchi di sconosciuti avversari, che uccidono i contrabbandieri e simpossessano dei diamanti. Divenuta Tiffany, cui egli ha rivelato la propria identità, sua alleata, Bond scopre, dopo aver evitato due volte di venire ucciso, che i diamanti trafugati allorganizzazione di Case sono finiti in un laboratorio spaziale, e utilizzati nella costruzione di un satellite, che sta per essere lanciato in orbita.

programme.desc: Tehran, 1979. Iranian Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi flees to the United States during the revolution. The American embassy in Tehran was then stormed by revolutionaries and six US citizens took refuge in the Canadian ambassador's residence. To bring their countrymen home, the CIA organized a daring rescue mission. / Teheran, 1979. Lo Scia iraniano Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, durante la rivoluzione, fugge negli Stati Uniti. Lambasciata americana di Teheran venne quindi presa dassalto dai rivoluzionari e sei cittadini statunitensi si rifugiarono nella residenza dellambasciatore canadese. programme.title: Night at the museum / La nuit au musee
programme.desc: Larry is a dreamer with a big heart and legendary bad luck. The day he accepts the position of night watchman at the Natural History Museum, he is far from suspecting that an incredible experience awaits him. / Larry est un reveur au grand coeur et à la malchance legendaire. Le jour où il accepte le poste de gardien de nuit au Musee dHistoire Naturelle, il est loin de se douter quune experience incroyable lattend.

programme.title: The Hunter and the Ice Queen / Le chasseur et la reine des glaces
programme.desc: Long before her adventure with Snow White, Ravenna led a peaceful existence with her sister Freya... until Freya fell in love. Alas, the latter's happiness is short-lived. Having the power to freeze whatever she wants, Freya decides to leave the kingdom to form her own army of children and forbids them from love. / Bien avant son aventure avec Blanche-Neige, Ravenna mène avec sa soeur Freya une existence paisible... jusquà ce que Freya tombe amoureuse. Helas, le bonheur de cette dernière est de courte duree. Ayant le pouvoir de geler ce quelle veut, Freya decide de quitter le royaume afin de constituer sa propre armee denfants et leur interdit lamour.

programme.title: The Scorpion King / Le roi Scorpion
programme.desc: 5,000 years before our era, the legendary city of Gomorrah is under the control of an evil tyrant, determined to eliminate the peoples of the desert. Threatened with extinction, they forget their centuries-old quarrels and prepare a response together. Knowing that their adversary is inspired by the visions and prophecies of a sorcerer, they hire an assassin, Mathayus, to kill him. / 5 000 ans avant notre ère, la legendaire cite de Gomorrhe est sous la coupe dun tyran malefique, bien decide à eliminer les peuplades du desert. Menacees dextinction, celles-ci en oublient leurs querelles seculaires et preparent ensemble une riposte. Sachant que leur adversaire sinspire des visions et propheties dun sorcier, elles engagent un assassin, Mathayus, pour le tuer.

programme.title: Switzerland seen from the sky / La suisse vue du ciel
programme.desc: A documentary series that explores Switzerland from the sky. / Une serie documentaire qui part à la decouverte de la Suisse vue du ciel.

programme.title: Esme and Roy / Esme et Roy
programme.desc: Tillie is having a really bad day. She spilled her monster bubbles, her doll is full of mud, her favorite dessert is gone. It’s official…she has rot. Esme and Roy will therefore have to find a way to make her feel better. / Tillie passe une très mauvaise journee. Elle a renverse ses monstro-bulles, sa poupee est pleine de boue, il n’y a plus de son dessert prefere. C’est officiel… elle a la pourricèle. Esme et Roy devront donc trouver un moyen pour qu’elle se sente mieux.

programme.title: Esme and Roy / Esme et Roy
programme.desc: Fig wants to do everything by herself, she wants to dress, eat, and fill the pool by herself. But some tasks are too complicated for a baby monster. Esme and Roy will therefore have to teach her that she has the right to ask for help. / Fig veut tout faire toute seule, elle veut s’habiller, manger, et remplir la piscine toute seule. Mais certaines tâches sont trop compliquees pour un bebe monstre. Esme et Roy devront donc lui apprendre qu’elle a le droit de demander de l’aide.

programme.title: The three Bricochons / Les trois Bricochons
programme.desc: Laura dreams of floating on a cloud! The Bricochons make a big floating cushion, but it’s so relaxing that Wilf falls asleep on it… and flies away! The Bricochons must quickly catch up with this cloud before it disappears far away! / Laura reve de flotter sur un nuage ! Les Bricochons fabriquent un gros coussin flottant, mais il est si relaxant que Wilf s’endort dessus… et s’envole ! Les Bricochons doivent vite rattraper ce nuage avant qu’il ne disparaisse au loin !

programme.title: The three Bricochons / Les trois Bricochons
programme.desc: Bruno is organizing a treasure hunt for the Bricochons, with special riddles for construction experts! But Wilf wants to find the treasure before anyone else... and keep it for himself. It risks ruining this memorable day! / Bruno organise une chasse au tresor pour les Bricochons, avec des enigmes speciales pour les experts en construction ! Mais Wilf veut trouver le tresor avant tout le monde… et le garder pour lui. Il risque de gâcher cette journee memorable !

programme.title: The three Bricochons / Les trois Bricochons
programme.desc: Wilf calls the Bricochons to repair his roof, but it's actually a ruse! Because Wilf locks himself in their house, in order to devour the pie planned for snack time with the neighbors. Give up the party? For the Bricochons, it’s impossible! / Wilf appelle les Bricochons pour reparer son toit, mais c’est en realite une ruse ! Car Wilf s’enferme chez eux, afin de devorer la tarte prevue pour le goûter avec les voisins. Renoncer à la fete ? Pour les Bricochons, cest impossible !

programme.title: Millie D's Stories Illustrated / Les histoires de Millie D illustrees
programme.sub-title: La leçon de seduction des animaux
programme.desc: In each episode, the very curious fairy Millie D tells a story to children about what interests them, while introducing them to Switzerland. / A chaque episode, la fee Millie D très curieuse, raconte une histoire aux enfants sur ce qui les interesse, tout en leur faisant decouvrir la Suisse.

programme.title: The Smurfs / Les Schtroumpfs
programme.desc: While Tempete claims to not be afraid of anything, Prankster Smurf challenges her to go to a cave in the middle of the night, to tell her scary stories. / Tandis que Tempete affirme navoir peur de rien, le Schtroumpf Farceur la defie de se rendre en pleine nuit dans une grotte, pour lui raconter des histoires effrayantes.

programme.title: The Smurfs / Les Schtroumpfs
programme.desc: Following an incident, the shadow of Strong Smurf comes to life and rebels because it wants to be free to do what it wants. But once without his shadow, Strong Smurf loses his strength and begins to disappear. / À la suite dun incident, lombre du Schtroumpf Costaud prend vie et se rebelle car elle veut etre libre de faire ce quelle veut. Mais une fois sans son ombre, le Schtroumpf Costaud perd ses forces et commence à disparaître.

programme.title: The Smurfs / Les Schtroumpfs
programme.desc: To monitor Papa Smurf and Tempete captures, Gargamel brings to life Lucretia, Rowena's doll, to make her a prison guard who is a little too authoritarian... / Pour surveiller le Grand Schtroumpf et Tempete captures, Gargamel donne vie à Lucretia, la poupee de Rowena, pour en faire une gardienne de prison un peu trop autoritaire…

programme.title: Once upon a time... these funny objects / Il etait une fois... ces drôles d’objets
programme.sub-title: Il etait une fois… Le thermomètre
programme.desc: Maestro is delighted to go to the sea but, at the airport, a thermal camera detects a fever and he is barred from the plane! To prove that he is not sick, Maestro decides to take his temperature with his friend the doctor Hippocrates in -400! But without a measuring instrument, its diagnosis remains approximate... / Maestro se rejouit de partir à la mer mais, à laeroport, une camera thermique lui detecte de la fièvre et on lui interdit laccès à lavion ! Pour prouver quil nest pas malade, Maestro decide daller prendre sa temperature chez son ami le medecin Hippocrate en -400 ! Mais sans instrument de mesure, son diagnostic reste approximatif...

programme.title: Once upon a time... these funny objects / Il etait une fois... ces drôles d’objets
programme.sub-title: Il etait une fois... Le feu de circulation
programme.desc: By taxi, carriage or bicycle, Maestro goes from green lights to red lights and goes back in time to tell us the origins of traffic lights. First simple wooden panels, then sound installations, they will become luminous in the 20th century and Maestro will explain to us the choice of their three colors: red, orange, green. / En taxi, en calèche ou à velo, Maestro va de feux verts en feux rouges et remonte le temps pour nous raconter lorigine des feux de circulation. Dabord simples panneaux de bois, puis installations sonores, ils deviendront lumineux au 20ème siècle et Maestro nous expliquera le choix de leurs trois couleurs : rouge, orange, vert.

programme.title: Diane and Gaëtan, it’s now! / Diane and Gaëtan, cest maintenant!
programme.desc: To “get the banana” every Sunday, we sing, we cook, we craft, we go out and we explore. Gaëtan and young Diane deploy a whole range of proposals to entertain the children. There is something for all tastes, all curiosities. Aimed at children up to 12 years old and families, this new event offers activities to do at home or outside. / Pour "choper la banane" tous les dimanches, on chante, on cuisine, on bricole, on sort et on explore. Gaëtan et la jeune Diane deploient toute une palette de propositions pour amuser les enfants. Il y en a pour tous les goûts, toutes les curiosites. Destinee aux enfants jusquà 12 ans et aux familles, ce nouveau rendez-vous propose des activites à realiser à la maison ou à lexterieur.

programme.title: The Thieves / Les Chapardeurs
programme.desc: With bees running out, Arrietty and Yuna go on a mission to pollinate strawberries. Once the mission is accomplished, they discover the presence of a very weakened bee and decide to transport it to the kitchen in order to warm it up and feed it. But the return of Marie and Jeremy will complicate the rescue operation and, despite Gurnard's help, our heroes will have difficulty getting the bee out of the kitchen once reinvigorated. / Les abeilles venant à manquer, Arrietty et Yuna partent en mission de pollinisation des fraisiers. Une fois la mission accomplie, elles decouvrent la presence d’une abeille très affaiblie et decident de la transporter dans la cuisine afin de la rechauffer et de la nourrir. Mais le retour de Marie et de Jeremy va compliquer l’operation de sauvetage et, malgre l’aide de Gurnard, nos heros auront bien du mal à faire sortir l’abeille de la cuisine une fois revigoree.

programme.title: The Thieves / Les Chapardeurs
programme.desc: When Hoppy takes a liking to a little ant, Arrietty helps him keep it a secret, despite the advice of the Davenport parents... The ant has such an appetite that Arrietty and Hoppy have to draw more and more from the Pilferers' reserves. We will have to part with it. Not obvious, because now it is no longer an ant, but a whole colony that is there. / Quand Hoppy se prend daffection pour une petite fourmi, Arrietty laide à la garder secrète, malgre lavis des parents Davenport... La fourmi a tellement d’appetit qu’Arrietty et Hoppy doivent de plus en plus piocher dans les reserves des Chapardeurs. Il va falloir s’en separer. Pas evident, car maintenant, ce n’est plus une fourmi, mais toute une colonie qui est là.

programme.title: Runes / Runes
programme.desc: Dagmar, Alice's father, is back from his expedition! He does not take kindly to Hugo's presence, which puts his family in danger. Seeking to locate his dragon skull, Loki goes to the Well of Urd and tasks Brunhilde with eliminating Hugo in exchange for his freedom. Armed with a magic sword, Brunhilde attacks Hugo and Turstin by surprise but Dagmar intervenes, giving Hugo the opportunity to annihilate the specter. / Dagmar, le père d’Alice, est de retour d’expedition ! Il ne voit pas d’un bon oeil la presence d’Hugo qui met sa famille en danger. Cherchant à localiser son crâne de dragon, Loki se rend au Puits d’Urd et charge Brunhilde d’eliminer Hugo en echange de sa liberte. Armee d’une epee magique, Brunhilde attaque Hugo et Turstin par surprise mais Dagmar s’interpose, donnant à Hugo l’occasion d’aneantir le spectre.

programme.title: Runes / Runes
programme.desc: The children, who set out in search of the dragon skull, are intrigued by strange flights of crows. They discover that the birds are protecting a dead tree. Thanks to a runic spell, Hugo controls them, allowing the discovery of the skull. Betrayed by Kin, the children must abandon their discovery to Loki. But Wace managed to steal a gem making it impossible to resurrect the dragon. / Les enfants, partis en quete du crâne de dragon, sont intrigues par d’etranges vols de corbeaux. Ils decouvrent que les oiseaux protègent un arbre mort. Grâce à un sort runique, Hugo les maîtrise, permettant la decouverte du crâne. Trahis par Kin, les enfants doivent abandonner leur decouverte à Loki. Mais Wace est parvenu à subtiliser une gemme rendant impossible la resurrection du dragon.

programme.title: Hilda / Hilda
programme.desc: Steven and the Crystal Gems are searching for the Shooting Star, an ancestral gem. Faced with the danger that awaits them, the Gems decide to shelter Steven in the Temple. There our hero breaks a bubble and accidentally releases a monster, the Mille-pinces. Witnessing the scene, the Gems decide to intervene but Steven intervenes and decides to tame this monster who for him is above all a being worthy of love. / Steven et les Gemmes de Cristal sont à la recherche de lEtoile Filante une gemme ancestrale. Devant le danger qui les guette les Gemmes decident de mettre Steven à labri au Temple. Là-bas notre heros brise une bulle et libère malencontreusement un monstre le Mille-pinces. Assistant à la scène les Gemmes decident dintervenir mais Steven sinterpose et decide dapprivoiser ce monstre qui pour lui est avant tout un etre digne damour.

programme.title: Hilda / Hilda
programme.desc: Our friends are at the courthouse dressed as members of the Justice League. Their mission will be to confront Darkseid to free the members of the League who are being held prisoner on Akopolips. Cyborg has always dreamed of becoming an active member of the League and is counting on this mission to be spotted... / Nos amis sont au Palais de Justice habilles comme les membres de la Ligue des Justicier. programme.title: NZZ Standpunkte / NZZ Standpunkte
programme.sub-title: Nabelschau und Naivitat: Die Schweiz stolpert in die Ära Trump
programme.desc: Bundesbern scheint es nicht mehr gewohnt zu sein, sich in einem nicht eben freundlichen Umfeld zu behaupten. Das diplomatische Feingefuhl, um mit Grossmachten umzugehen und die aussenpolitische Balance zu halten, zeichnete die Schweiz einst aus. Es war einer der Grunde fur ihr Fortbestehen inmitten eines immer wieder kriegerischen Europas.Mit den neuen Zeiten, die spatestens mit dem Ausbruch des Ukraine-Kriegs und dem Wahlsieg von Donald Trump angebrochen sind, tut sich die Schweiz schwer. Bei den Verhandlungen zu den amerikanischen Zollen macht der Bundesrat eine schlechte Figur. Statt dass wir wie die EU oder Grossbritannien einen verhaltnismassig guten Deal mit den Vereinigten Staaten abschliessen konnen, treffen uns hohe Handelszolle. Als Kleinstaat mit offener Wirtschaft stellt die Volatilitat fur die Schweiz eine besondere Herausforderung dar. Welche Hausaufgaben muss sie erledigen, um ihnen zu begegnen und sich fur die Zukunft zu rusten?Tobias Straumann ist Wirtschaftshistoriker und Professor an der Universitat Zurich. programme.title: Cuntrasts / Cuntrasts
programme.sub-title: Der Schatz von Samedan – Geschichte in Gold, Tull und Wolle
programme.desc: Dieses Jahr konnte die Chesa Planta endlich eine wissenschaftliche Inventarisierung in Auftrag geben – und die Textilhistorikerinnen Thessy Schoenholzer Nichols und Briony Langmead sowie der Designer und Kostumbildner Bernhard Duss zeigen sich begeistert von der Samedner Sammlung. Einzigartig macht sie ihre Herkunft aus dem Hab und Gut der beiden Adelsfamilien de Salis und de Planta. programme.title: SRF DOK / SRF DOK
programme.sub-title: Mutter unter Vertrag – Leihmutterschaft in Georgien
programme.desc: «Mutter unter Vertrag» erzahlt von Liebe, Aufopferung und dem Kampf einer Mutter fur eine Zukunft jenseits von Stigma, Armut und Tabu. Zhana war noch ein Teenager, als sie ihre Tochter Elene bekam. Selbst aufgewachsen im Waisenhaus und auf den Strassen von Tiflis, will sie ihrer Tochter ein besseres Leben ermoglichen – und entscheidet sich, als Leihmutter Geld dazu zu verdienen. In Georgien ist kommerzielle Leihmutterschaft legal, aber kaum reguliert. Vermittlungsagenturen florieren, der soziale Druck ist hoch, und viele Frauen verheimlichen ihre Tatigkeit sogar vor der eigenen Familie. In der Öffentlichkeit gelten sie als «Kinderverkauferinnen» – ein Stigma, das sie zur Unsichtbarkeit zwingt. Die Regisseurin Ketevan Vashagashvili kennt Zhana seit vielen Jahren. Sie begleitet Zhana mit grosser Nahe auf dem Weg durch ihre dritte Leihmutterschaft – und zeigt eindrucklich die Auswirkungen auf das Leben von Mutter und Tochter. Die Dokumentation zeigt nicht nur Zhanas Ängste, Kampfe und Hoffnungen, sondern auch ihr fragiles Verhaltnis zu ihrer Tochter Elene. Die Gesprache uber Leihmutterschaft, Verantwortung und Zukunft bleiben schwierig – auch nach Jahren. «Mutter unter Vertrag» ist eine emotionale Dokumentation uber Mutterschaft, Aufopferung und gesellschaftliche Ausgrenzung. programme.title: FENSTER ZUM SONNTAG – Talk / FENSTER ZUM SONNTAG – Talk
programme.desc: Eine Appenzellerin wird wahrend eines Sprachaufenthalts von einem Mann aus Sudostasien schwanger. Nicht ahnend, dass er Prinz und Nachkomme eines Sultans ist und sein Vater Chefminister von Sabah in Malaysia. Sie heiraten und bekommen einen Sohn. Amir Khalid wachst zwischen verschiedenen Welten auf, sucht Zugehorigkeit im Sport und der Hip-Hop-Kultur. Er gehort zu den ersten Breakdance-Crews der Schweiz. Zuruck in Malaysia werden er und sein Vater mutmasslich von der Stiefmutter vergiftet. Amir uberlebt knapp, sein Vater stirbt.Mit 19 flieht er orientierungslos zuruck in die Schweiz. Aus einer Suche wird Sucht. Er gerat in Drogen, ein LSD-Trip lost eine Psychose aus. Als er Christ wird, verstosst und enterbt ihn sein Grossvater, der Sabah mit diktatorischer Strenge verstarkt islamisierte. Mit 32 Jahren wird er voll aus dem Berufs- und Familienleben gerissen: Herzinsuffizienz. Nach einer zwolfjahrigen Leidenszeit erhalt er durch eine Transplantation ein neues Herz – auch fur die Familie, die ihn verstiess und andere Stammesleute aus der Sulu-See. / Eine Appenzellerin wird wahrend eines Sprachaufenthalts von einem Mann aus Sudostasien schwanger.
